attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Replaces the custom JSONPath implementation with JsonPath.Net semantics (now requiring '$'-rooted, RFC 9535 syntax) in a widely-used public API (JNode.SelectNode used throughout content management, GraphQL, migrations, etc.), and while it attempts backward compatibility for simple paths, more complex existing JSONPath expressions or edge cases (e.g. array indexing, wildcards) could behave differently and break downstream modules/themes relying on the old behavior."}
